tasks.evidence: A monochrome separator/guide colour partitions framed panels; removing the guide and reflowing the intact panel payloads exactly explains every training output.
Embedded marker glyphs drive region recolouring as well as layout; this is a broader scene renderer than the v1 object-placement candidate.
A boundary cue orders selected interior components into a new strip; this overlaps the rejected object selection/extraction axis.
All bounded payload objects are preserved and joined by unique matching marker cells into one compact scene.
Multiple separator-delimited symbol tables expand stencils compositionally; this requires learned symbolic substitution beyond either v1 candidate.
Uniform separator lines split equal-sized panels; the output removes separators and concatenates the panels on the uniquely inferred perpendicular axis.
A connected multicolour path is converted into a one-cell-wide ordered sequence; this is extraction/linearization, not panel reflow.
One unique scaffold and its marker cells determine placements for every remaining payload object while preserving their internal pixels.
One region supplies a stencil and another supplies a repeating motif; their product expands a new grid and overlaps pattern-completion territory.

candidates.operation: Detect one unique full-span separator colour, split the grid into intact rectangular panels, remove only separator cells/lines, and concatenate the panels on the single axis and order that reproduces every training output.
activation_guards: Exactly one separator colour and one panel partition are valid across every training pair.
Every output cell comes from an unchanged input panel cell; no recolouring, synthesis, crop-to-selected-object, scaling, or overlap is permitted.
One axis/order choice must reproduce every training output exactly and all panels must be consumed exactly once.
The inferred rule must change dimensions on at least one training pair and remain deterministic when the input panel orientation changes.
reject_when: More than one separator, partition, panel order, or output axis is train-consistent.
Panel shapes are incompatible without padding, clipping, overlap, recolouring, or invented cells.
The transformation is expressible as whole-grid transpose, crop, scale, tile, or object selection alone.
Any training output cell cannot be traced to exactly one preserved panel cell.
candidates.non_overlap: Unlike contextual recolour it never changes a payload value; unlike object selection/extraction it consumes every panel; unlike pattern completion it invents no motif cells.

candidates.operation: Identify one unique scaffold or connector relation and place every bounded payload object into one compact output using only uniquely matching marker cells; preserve each payload's orientation and internal pixels.
activation_guards: All non-background payload objects and exactly one scaffold/connector relation are identifiable in every training input.
Every payload is used exactly once and every placement is fixed by a unique marker match.
The same placement rule reproduces every training output exactly without recolouring, rotating, reflecting, scaling, or filling missing pixels.
No output may be explained by selecting a strict subset of payload objects.
reject_when: A marker has multiple compatible placements or any payload has no unique placement.
Assembly requires dropping an object, changing its internal pixels, resolving overlap by precedence, or synthesising a region.
The scaffold is not unique or a plain crop/selection, global colour map, or periodic completion also fits.
Any changed training cell is not accounted for by rigid placement of a preserved payload.
candidates.non_overlap: This assembles all preserved objects by structural markers; it neither selects/extracts a subset, recolours contextually, nor completes a periodic pattern.

promotion_gate.decision: Each candidate must pass screen and independent confirm separately. Activation or training fit without task-level exact output is not a pass.

next_stage.on_failure: Revert solver behaviour and retain only this specification plus measured rejection evidence.
next_stage.on_pass: Prove stdin-exec compatibility, then package the identical solver for Kaggle and require external evidence before registry or champion promotion.
